title: Bennett & Lennett
description: Dev log from Bennett & Lennett, making Hemmeligheden på Fyns Hoved, a comedic point-and-click adventure set on Fyns Hoved in Denmark.

lookAt: My hat is a bit tight, I know.
A sweater made for a seaman, got it on one of my adventures.. into town.
The wheels are squeaks when I walk, but it's my signature sound.
talkTo: No time to talk, I am going to get Jola.
